value: Sets who the policy applies to: ministries and federal authorities and non-government CII entities; emirate government entities are covered directly where there is no emirate CIIP programme, and otherwise the Emirate Lead carries out applicability assessment, enforcement and monitoring. Exceptions may be granted case by case by the Emirate or Sector Lead or the CSC. Compliance is monitored through UAE Information Assurance Standard controls (Appendix E.2), with status reported on the National Cyber Index Platform. Version 1.0 is dated September 2025; Version 1.1 (November 2025) revised the structure and statements. AI ethics, fairness and trustworthiness are stated to be outside scope (s1.1).
